messages.content:
Reply with one JSON object only, matching this JSON schema:
{"description": "A sewn-in care label: composition and care symbols, as printed.", "properties": {"composition": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "fibre composition exactly as printed, e.g. '100% polyester'"}, "wash_max_temp_c": {"anyOf": [{"type": "integer"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "temperature in the wash-tub symbol; null if not washable"}, "do_not_wash": {"description": "the wash tub is crossed out", "type": "boolean"}, "dry_clean_only": {"description": "only professional / dry cleaning is allowed", "type": "boolean"}, "removable_cover": {"description": "the label says the cover is removable", "type": "boolean"}, "other_text": {"description": "any other text on the label, as printed", "items": {"type": "string"}, "type": "array"}}, "required": ["composition", "wash_max_temp_c", "do_not_wash", "dry_clean_only", "removable_cover", "other_text"], "type": "object"}

content.text: This is a care label sewn into upholstery or a rug. Read the printed text and the care symbols: the wash tub (with a temperature, or crossed out), the triangle (bleach), the iron, and a circle (professional / dry cleaning). Report only what is printed.

response.content: {"composition": "100% POLYESTER", "wash_max_temp_c": 30, "do_not_wash": false, "dry_clean_only": false, "removable_cover": true, "other_text": ["ARREDO BRIANZA S.R.L.", "LEC-05", "100% POLIESTERE", "Fodera sfoderabile", "Removable cover", "Prodotto in Italia"]}
